settings:
# Exploratory controls (08.11.2026, branch explore), chosen after the main results. Synthetic data
# built in memory (src/dfx/datasets.py), 1,000 rows each, 3 seeds as in positive.toml.
# - wide_xor, wide_pair: the positive control with 28 noise features (435 candidate products, K = 30).
# - raw_xor, raw_pair: a multiplicative interaction of positive features on their raw scale, where
#   products of mean-centred features pivot at the wrong point. Expected if centring matters: the
#   "raw" check helps here and the default products do not.
datasets = ["wide_xor", "wide_pair", "raw_xor", "raw_pair"]
seeds = [0, 1, 2]
outer_folds = 5

[[check]]
name = "default"
methods = ["base", "random_xx", "target_xx", "residual_xx", "shuffled_xx", "rf", "rf_target_xx", "lightgbm"]

[[check]]
name = "raw"
methods = ["target_xx", "residual_xx", "rf_target_xx"]
cascade = { product_origin = "raw" }
